probe_finding: Definition (author @RyNoonan, data: SumerSports via 4for4, read 2026-10-15): TACKLING EFFICIENCY VS RUN — a defender's tackling success rate against the run (min 70 snaps), published with the league average of 17.55% carried on the chart as the baseline every name is read against. Role in-engine: the run-defense member of Noonan's vs-expected family (C-299/C-300/C-301) — where tackles vs expected measures VOLUME against opportunity, tackling efficiency measures CONVERSION against the run, and the two disagree exactly where a defender is busy but not finishing. The published league baseline (17.55%) is recorded so future instances have their denominator context.
